item.tib: theg pa chen po bsdus pa'i 'grel pa
item.skt: na hA yA na sang gra ha b+hY Sh+yaM
item.coloph: theg pa chen po bsdus pa'i 'grel pa/ theg pa chen po la rab tu gnas pa bstan bcos phul du byung ba du ma mdzad pa'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dI paM ka ra shrI dz+nyA na dang / lo tsA ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas/ yul brag dmar lha sdings/ ri has po ri'i rtse/ chu bo lo hi ti'i 'gram/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ dbyig 'du dpe dkar gling du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa/ 'di la sh+lo ka nyis stong chig brgya brgyad cu yod do/ bam po brgyad du byas so
